validation.observed_symptom: A physical press activates the target window, but holding the press while moving does not select text.

requested_mac_diagnostics.scenario: Place one finger on the trackpad, press and hold for two seconds while moving, then release.
required_trace: Every raw MTRegisterButtonStateCallback invocation with pressed and released integer arguments.
Every emitted button transition with sequence, frame flags, and contact_count.
requested_mac_diagnostics.acceptance_condition: TP_FRAME_BUTTON remains set on every contact frame from physical down until physical release.

notes: Do not pass the literal placeholder WINDOWS_IP to mac-touch-agent.
Physical press validation requires button_events to increase on both press and release.
The current symptom is consistent with a short button pulse rather than a held level.
Write the Mac trace and result to handoff/mac-validation.json and commit it for the Windows agent.
